title: Umusa
author: Lumni
content:
# Umusa

Kudala, kwakukhona intombazane encane egama linguThandi. Wayehlala emzini omncane eduze kwehlathi elikhulu. Thandi wayaziwa ngobuhle benhliziyo yakhe — wayehlale esiza wonke umuntu owayeswele.

Ngenye imini, uThandi wahamba eya esikoleni. Endleleni wabona indoda endala ehleli emthunzini womuthi. Wayebukeka ekhathele futhi elambile.

"Sawubona, Mkhulu," kusho uThandi. "Kungani uhlala lapha wedwa?"

"Sawubona, ngane yami," kuphendula indoda. "Ngihamba ibanga elide kodwa anginamandla okuqhubeka."

UThandi wakhipha isinkwa sakhe esincane nesiphuzo samanzi. "Nansi into yokudla, Mkhulu. Akukuningi, kodwa ngiyakwabelana nawe."

Indoda yamamatheka. "Ngiyabonga, ngane yami. Umusa wakho mkhulu kunokudla ongipha khona."

UThandi waqhubeka nendlela yakhe. Ngalolo suku, wenzé izehlo eziningi zomusa. Wasiza umfanyana owayekhale ngoba wayelahlekelwe yibhola lakhe. Wasiza umama owayethwele umthwalo osindayo. Watshela utishala wakhe ngenkosazana eyayingenawo amapensela.

Ntambama, uThandi wafika ekhaya. Umama wakhe wambuza: "Kwenzenjani namuhla esikoleni, ndodakazi yami?"

UThandi waxoxa konke okwenzekile. Umama wakhe wamgona futhi wathi: "Umusa wakho ufana nembewu encane. Uma uyitshala, ikhula ibe yisihlahla esikhulu. Namuhla utshale izimbewu eziningi zomusa."

Ngakusasa, uThandi wathola into emangalisayo. Abantu ababemsizile babemlethele izipho. Indoda endala yamlethela izithelo ezinhle. Umfanyana wamlethela umqhele wezimbali. Intokozo yagcwalisa inhliziyo kaThandi.

## Izifundo

1. **Umusa uyatheleleka** — Uma wenza okuhle kwabanye, ukuhle kuyabuya kuwe.
2. **Akukuningi okudingekayo** — Ngisho isenzo esincane somusa singashintsha usuku lomuntu.
3. **Ukuhlanganyela** — Ukwabelana nalabo abaswele kusenza sibe ngabantu abangcono.
